project_description: DevReview AI — an automated code-review platform powered by AI. Users connect their GitHub repositories, receive AI-driven code reviews on pull requests, collaborate with team members, and visualise code diagrams and diffs directly in the browser.

pages.name: Landing Page
pages.description: Public marketing page: hero, stats, features, how-it-works, languages, CTA, footer

pages.name: Sign In
pages.description: Email/password sign-in form and GitHub OAuth button

pages.name: Sign Up
pages.description: Registration form with name, email, and password fields

pages.name: Repositories
pages.description: Dashboard: lists connected GitHub repos with stats. User can connect new repos from their GitHub account or disconnect existing ones

pages.name: Repository Detail
pages.description: Shows a single repository's pull requests, AI review history, and statistics

pages.name: Pull Request Review
pages.description: Full AI-generated code review for a pull request: diff viewer, inline comments, code timeline, collaborative comments, and ER-diagram

pages.name: All Reviews
pages.description: Aggregated list of all AI reviews across all connected repos

pages.name: Analytics
pages.description: Charts and metrics: review activity over time, language breakdown, issue severity distribution

pages.name: Teams
pages.description: Manage teams: create a team, invite members via email, view member list, manage roles

pages.name: Team Detail
pages.description: Individual team page: members, shared repos, activity feed

pages.name: Settings
pages.description: User preferences (theme, notifications), active sessions management

pages.name: Profile
pages.description: Edit display name, avatar upload, and account information

pages.name: Admin Panel
pages.description: Admin-only: user management, system analytics, audit log, security settings, support tickets

user_flows.name: User Registration
steps: Fill in name, email, and password
Expect redirect to /repo after successful registration

user_flows.name: Sign In Validation
steps: Expect inline validation errors for email and password fields

user_flows.name: Connect a GitHub Repository
steps: Select a repository from the GitHub list panel
Expect the repo card to appear in the connected repos list

user_flows.name: View PR Review
steps: Navigate to a repository detail page
Expect the AI review page to load with diff viewer and comments

user_flows.name: Theme Toggle
steps: Click the theme toggle in the header/settings
Expect the page colour scheme to switch between light and dark

user_flows.name: Create a Team
steps: Expect the new team to appear in the teams list

test_credentials.note: Set TEST_EMAIL and TEST_PASSWORD env vars or use the sign-up flow to create a test account

api_endpoints.description: tRPC router — all data queries and mutations
